# `browser-extension/services/ExtensionSenderPolicy.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/ExtensionSenderPolicy.js`

Authenticate privileged runtime messages from this extension's own pages. Extension pages opened in a popup window can have sender.tab; content scripts also have sender.tab, so ownership must be decided from the sender URL/origin rather than from tab presence alone.

## Functions

### `isExtensionPageSender(sender, runtimeId)`

Authenticate privileged runtime messages from this extension's own pages. Extension pages opened in a popup window can have sender.tab; content scripts also have sender.tab, so ownership must be decided from the sender URL/origin rather than from tab presence alone.
